result_summary:
This is the same root cause I diagnosed last turn for the sibling tile — no new bug, just the other tile in the pair.

**Root cause (unchanged):** the "Income Tax - Block Level Context (Not Asset-Specific) + Estimated Allocation" tile runs visual `fam_dep_it_block_context`, whose SQL correctly selects from `fam_dep_income_tax_block` — the exact `target_table` declared in General Process `fam_gen_dep_income_tax`. That table is only auto-created on the process's **first successful Execute**, and per `live_tables` it still doesn't exist in the live database (I re-checked below). The visual model's own `SCHEMA_DESCR` already documents this as expected until the process is run at least once.Confirmed: `fam_dep_income_tax_block` still doesn't exist. Nothing changed since last turn on this front.

**No file changes made** — same as the Companies Act tile, this is not a model bug. `fam_dep_income_tax_block` is the `target_table` of General Process **"Generate Depreciation - Income Tax (Block)"** (`fam_gen_dep_income_tax`), and per platform behavior a `persist_mode: "table"` target is only auto-created on that process's **first successful Execute**. It hasn't been run yet, so the table genuinely doesn't exist — the query, the visual (`fam_dep_it_block_context`), and the dashboard tile are all correctly built.

**To fix it:** open the General Process **"Generate Depreciation - Income Tax (Block)"** in the app, run **Generate** for a financial year, review the block rows, then **Execute** (Approve & Post) at least once. That creates `fam_dep_income_tax_block`, and this tile will then render live data instead of erroring — same step needed for the Companies Act sibling table.

If you'd like, I can seed this by walking through what values `fam_gen_dep_income_tax` needs (financial year / branch), but I can't run the process myself — running it requires the interactive review-and-execute step in the live preview.
